subject: science
domain: Waves and Their Applications in Technologies for Information Transfer

items.prompt:
The wave speed equation is
A) speed = frequency x wavelength
B) speed = frequency + wavelength
C) speed = frequency / wavelength
D) speed = mass x acceleration

Frequency is measured in
A) hertz (Hz)
B) meters
C) kilograms
D) newtons

A wave with frequency 2 Hz and wavelength 3 m has a speed of
A) 6 m/s
B) 5 m/s
C) 1.5 m/s
D) 0.67 m/s

For a fixed speed, if frequency increases, wavelength
A) decreases
B) increases
C) stays the same
D) becomes zero

steps: Higher frequency means shorter wavelength at fixed speed.

items.prompt:
A wave with frequency 5 Hz and wavelength 2 m has a speed of
A) 10 m/s
B) 7 m/s
C) 2.5 m/s
D) 3 m/s

A wave travels at 12 m/s with a wavelength of 4 m. Its frequency is
A) 3 Hz
B) 48 Hz
C) 16 Hz
D) 8 Hz

A wave travels at 20 m/s with a frequency of 4 Hz. Its wavelength is
A) 5 m
B) 80 m
C) 24 m
D) 0.2 m

For a fixed wave speed, a lower frequency goes with a
A) longer wavelength
B) shorter wavelength
C) zero wavelength
D) higher speed

steps: Lower frequency means longer wavelength at fixed speed.
